# Embed

A titled, sandboxed frame for third-party content (Genially, video, maps), with a link to open it on its own.

```tsx
import { Embed } from '@kafka-ds/react'
```

## When to use it

- For interactive pieces that cannot be reproduced in the page.

## When not to

- For content that is just text or an image.
- Without a title: an untitled frame is a silent box for screen reader users.

## Examples

### Loaded frame

A titled, sandboxed frame with a link to open the content on its own.

```tsx
<div className="max-w-xl">
  <Embed src="/embed-demo.html" title="Contenido de ejemplo" caption="Presentación interactiva." ratio="4/3" />
</div>
```

### Click to load

With `deferred`, nothing is requested from the provider until the reader asks for it.

```tsx
<div className="max-w-xl">
  <Embed src="/embed-demo.html" title="Presentación interactiva" caption="Se carga al pulsar el botón." ratio="16/9" deferred />
</div>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src` (required) | `string` |  | URL of the content to embed. |
| `title` (required) | `string` |  | Names the content for screen readers. Required: an iframe without a title is a silent box. |
| `ratio` | `'16/9' \| '4/3' \| '1/1'` | `'16/9'` | Shape of the frame. Interactive pieces are usually 16/9 or 4/3. |
| `caption` | `ReactNode` |  | Caption below the frame. |
| `deferred` | `boolean` | `false` | Waits for a click before loading the third-party page: faster reading, and nothing is sent to the provider until the reader asks. |
| `sandbox` | `string` | `'allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-forms allow-presentation allow-popups'` | Sandbox rules. The default allows scripts, forms, presentation and pop-ups, but not top navigation. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- **Title is required** and becomes the iframe `title`.
- **Sandbox:** scripts, forms, presentation and pop-ups are allowed; top navigation is not.
- **Privacy:** with `deferred`, nothing is requested from the provider until the reader clicks. Lazy loading and a strict referrer policy otherwise.
- **Escape hatch:** an "Open in a new tab" link, 44 px tall, for readers who cannot use the frame.
- **Keyboard:** focus enters and leaves the frame normally; the frame is not a trap.

## Content

- Say in the caption what the piece is and what to do with it.
